scene_description: A small office with a window blind above a light-wood cubby shelf, a floor lamp, a narrow white cabinet, a paneled door, two rolling chairs, a foreground table and a large plant.
initial_target_observations: Both initial chairs have curved pale shells, central dark support posts and wheeled bases. The farther chair's lower support is partly hidden by the table, while the nearer chair's post and base are visible. The initial view has a wide foreground table and a large plant obscuring part of the right side.
candidate_target_observations: Both candidate chairs retain curved shells and dark wheeled bases. The farther chair's post and base are partly obscured by the table; the nearer chair's post visibly runs from beneath the seat to the base, though its lowest wheels are cropped. Their pale shells and tall backs differ from the darker, lower, more rounded reference chairs. Visible supports do not establish actual mesh contact.
geometric_plausibility_observations: The candidate's visible chair posts and radial wheeled bases read as plausible supports, subject to occlusion and cropping. The reference door appears angled and open, while the candidate door appears flat against the wall. The candidate's furniture broadly occupies corresponding regions, but camera framing and chair silhouettes differ substantially.
new_visible_defects: The candidate crops the near chair's wheeled base at the bottom and most of the plant pot at the right, reducing visibility compared with the initial view. Black corner marks remain visible on the blind frame in both reconstructions.
other_changes: The candidate is more tightly framed and shifted toward the chairs and door than the initial image. The plant occupies less of the foreground, the table is more heavily cropped, and the candidate door appears darker. Both reconstructions use pale, relatively uniform flooring and simplified surfaces, unlike the reference's darker textured wood floor and warmer wood blind and shelf. The candidate is softly and evenly lit, with less contrast and texture than the reference.

evidence.description: Two rounded gray chairs have dark central posts and wheeled bases; the nearer base meets the lower frame edge.
Two light curved chair shells have visible dark support components; the farther base is partly hidden by the table.
The nearer chair's central post and radial base are visible, with the base cropped below; the table masks part of the farther chair support.
A dark paneled door leaf is visibly angled relative to the wall opening.
The paneled door appears nearly frontal and flush with the wall.
The large foreground plant obscures much of the lower right scene.
The plant is confined to the right edge, and its pot is outside the visible frame.
The floor has a distinct dark wood grain and plank pattern.
The floor has pale, largely uniform planks with understated texture.

uncertainty: No specific intended target change is identified. Chair support visibility is partly affected by viewpoint, table occlusion and cropping, so a change in underlying geometry cannot be reliably inferred. RGB images alone do not establish true contact, collision or hidden geometry.
